extracted.intended_audience: Faculty and faculty-led research teams at the University of Maryland (PIs, proposal teams, research administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Description of the University of Maryland Research Development Office services and guidance to help faculty and faculty-led groups identify funding, develop proposals, manage limited submissions, and prepare for finalist-stage interactions with funders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing a detailed understanding of the funding landscape
rubrics_metrics.description: developing a detailed understanding of the funding landscape
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RDO provides strategic intelligence about funders and funding trends to inform proposal targeting and research direction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultivating and maintaining strategic partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: cultivating and maintaining strategic partnerships with funding agencies, industry, foundations, and external partners
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports long-term relationship-building between faculty/units and external funders or partners to increase competitiveness for awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proactively assisting faculty to identify funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: proactively assisting faculty to identify funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Active identification and notification of relevant opportunities tailored to faculty research interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executing university-wide strategic initiatives and campus-wide programs
rubrics_metrics.description: executing university wide strategic initiatives and campus-wide programs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leads and coordinates initiatives that span units or the whole campus to align resources and launch major proposals or programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing the limited submissions grant applications process
rubrics_metrics.description: managing the limited submissions grant applications process
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administers internal competitions and selection processes when external sponsors limit the number of institutional submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Providing proposal development and management services for key proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: providing proposal development and management services for key proposals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers hands-on support for drafting, editing, coordinating budgets/attachments, and managing timelines for high-priority proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevating the look and impact of proposals and research products through graphics support
rubrics_metrics.description: elevating the look and impact of proposals and research products through graphics support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides data visualization, multimedia, and design services (e.g., figures, slides, posters) to improve clarity and reviewer impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting new and high-impact research via internal grants
rubrics_metrics.description: supporting new and high-impact research via internal grants, including the Maryland Catalyst Funds; Independent Scholarship, Research and Creativity Awards (ISRCA); MPower collaborations; and the Grand Challenges Grants program
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manages and promotes internal seed and strategic funding mechanisms to catalyze interdisciplinary and high-risk/high-reward research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delivering programming to increase faculty competitiveness for external funding
rubrics_metrics.description: delivering programming (including workshops, writing groups, panel presentations) to increase faculty competitiveness for external funding
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers training and peer-support formats (writing groups, panels, workshops) aimed at improving proposal quality and success rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitating and supporting visits from senior officials
rubrics_metrics.description: facilitating and supporting visits from senior officials from federal agencies, companies, and foundations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Arranges and supports campus interactions with funder representatives to build relationships and align campus priorities with funder interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing proposal teams for finalist-stage presentations
rubrics_metrics.description: preparing proposal teams to deliver responsive, cohesive, and impactful finalist-stage presentations (interviews, site visits, reverse site visits)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coaches and assembles materials for finalist interviews and site visits to ensure consistent messaging and strong team performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building research teams/partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Building research teams/partnerships
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curated guidance and actions to help faculty form interdisciplinary teams and external partnerships for specific funding opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requesting development or graphics support
rubrics_metrics.description: Requesting development or graphics support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for obtaining RDO proposal development help and graphic/data-visualization assistance for proposals and research products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understanding limited submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Understanding limited submissions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information and procedural guidance on how limited submission opportunities are handled internally (deadlines, nomination processes, selection criteria).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applying for internal seed grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Applying for internal seed grants
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on eligibility, application steps, and priorities for internal funding mechanisms such as catalyst or seed awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Securing mandatory cost share from the VPR/Provost
rubrics_metrics.description: Securing mandatory cost share from the VPR/Provost
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Process and expectations for requesting and obtaining institutional cost-share commitments required by some sponsors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using the Universal Funding Request Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Using the Universal Funding Request Form
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instructions for the campus-wide form used to request review, institutional approvals, or RDO assistance for potential funding opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requesting Letters of Support or Commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: Requesting Letters of Support or Commitment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how and when to request institutional letters and what information RDO requires to prepare letters for proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishing a Research Center Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishing a Research Center Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural and strategic guidance for proposing and organizing research centers at the university (expectations, approvals, and support).

rubrics_metrics.name: RDO Newsletter and strategic communications
rubrics_metrics.description: The RDO Newsletter | The Research Development Office produces a biweekly newsletter detailing unique funding opportunities, events, and strategic intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscribe or consult the newsletter repository for curated opportunities, events, and RDO updates.
